articles.title: Former F1 champion Jones dies aged 80
articles.description: Alan Jones, the last Australian and first Williams driver to win the Formula 1 world title, dies at the age of 80.

articles.title: Ocon dropped - is it the end of his F1 career?
articles.description: Esteban Ocon's career as a Formula 1 race driver is over - at least for the foreseeable future - after falling out with Haas. Andrew Benson looks at what the future holds for the Frenchman.

articles.title: More than the Score
articles.description: The 20-year-old Italian is the youngest F1 world champion ever

articles.title: Ocon dropped by Haas for rest of season after row
articles.description: F1 team Haas says Estaban Ocon will "no longer compete on its behalf in the 2026 world championship" after he was dropped for the Mexico Grand Prix.

articles.title: How sporting events are being affected by Middle East conflict
articles.description: BBC Sport takes a look at how the ongoing conflict in the Middle East has affected sporting events in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and the wider area.
